name: Slew
author: Airwindows (Chris Johnson, MIT licence)
description: Airwindows Slew2 by Chris Johnson: tames harsh, spiky highs by limiting how fast the wave can move - smooths cymbals, sibilance and brittle digital sound. Ported from Airwindows (MIT licence).
code:
// Airwindows Slew2, Copyright (c) 2018 Chris Johnson, MIT licence (LICENSE-airwindows.txt) - ported to Central FX
@init
dec = 0.915965594177219015
dd = dec * dec
tw = 0.0414213562373095048801688
@block
th = pow(1 - clamp, 4) / (2 / 44100 * srate)
go = db2gain(output)
@sample
x = inL
lsL = (x + l1L + (l3L - l2L) * tw) * 0.5
l3L = l2L; l2L = l1L; l1L = x
bL *= dec
hdf = bL * dec
y = clamp(x, lsL - th, lsL + th)
lsL = y
c = y - x
aL = aL * dd + c + 1e-20
bL = bL * dec - c + 1e-20
df = aL * dec
outL = (x + (df + hdf + pdL) / 0.734) * go
pdL = df * 0.5
x = inR
lsR = (x + l1R + (l3R - l2R) * tw) * 0.5
l3R = l2R; l2R = l1R; l1R = x
bR *= dec
hdf = bR * dec
y = clamp(x, lsR - th, lsR + th)
lsR = y
c = y - x
aR = aR * dd + c + 1e-20
bR = bR * dec - c + 1e-20
df = aR * dec
outR = (x + (df + hdf + pdR) / 0.734) * go
pdR = df * 0.5
